work.summary: Team Lead overseeing both the production office and packing departments within a medical kit production facility.
highlights: Plan, organize, supervise and participate in daily operation and activities, including the receipt, documentation, storage, safety and distribution of equipment and supplies.
Train, supervise and evaluate the performance of assigned employees; assign expectations and responsibilities to trainers and seniors.
Prepare and maintain a variety of records and logs and prepare reports as required; assist in maintenance of inventory training records; file records as required per leadership.
Monitor and update Kit Packing systems; operate a computer to enter data, correct errors and control key screens as required.
